goal: Build the measurable Organisation Intelligence Proof needed to show whether organisations act on source-backed civic intelligence they would otherwise miss.
constraints: Keep signals source-backed and uncertainty visible.
No external sends or commitments without approval.
done_when: A repeatable Intelligence Proof flow exists.
The flow measures whether a signal would otherwise have been missed and whether action followed.
uncertainties: Real willingness-to-pay and organisational usefulness still require external users after the proof flow is prepared.
next_step: Build the Organisation Intelligence Proof instrumentation and usefulness rubric, then prepare the first organisation-ready proof pack.

decision_estimate.rationale: The proof can convert civic intelligence infrastructure into a measurable user outcome, but external usefulness remains less certain than the strongest current proof opportunities.
